Speak to [[Headmaster Amara]] to begin your [[monk]] training.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Monk
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
* Seek out Headmaster Amara in the monastery.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s
* {{skill icon|Bane Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Orison of Healing}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Holy Rod]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Amara, who is to the right, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Ludo'''
:''"Ah, a young Monk! You should seek out '''Headmaster Amara''', the Monk headmaster, as she will take charge of your education. She has not left the '''monastery''' today, so I expect you will find her easily. Good luck!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Amara.
| decline = I'd rather look around, first.
| ask = Did you find '''Headmaster Amara'''? She is here in the monastery somewhere. It would not do to keep her waiting.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Headmaster Amara'''
:''"Yes, Ludo has a big heart, does he not? It is well that he is here to greet young, frightened students."''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
